operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: Start here: what the app is, how songs are written in ABC with words (w: lines), the levels, the vocalises, the microphone's limits, the health rules, the protocols for song requests, questions and session reviews.
operations.label: Guide app

topic.description: one part only: protocol|words|recordings|abc|health|levels|curriculum (all when left out)

operations.name: app.state
operations.description: The shell's one call: settings, the voice, today's health and load, unread coach messages, the open session.
operations.label: State app

operations.name: app.context
operations.description: What the person is looking at right now (view, song, bars, mode, key, lesson or drill) and their voice.
operations.label: Context app

operations.name: app.ui
operations.description: The page reports where the person is. (person only)
operations.label: Ui app

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The settings.
operations.label: Get setting

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change settings (the person only).
operations.label: Update setting

operations.name: voice.get
operations.description: The singer's voice: measured range, comfortable range, voice family and clef, passaggio estimate, sustain, history of range tests.
operations.label: Get voice

operations.name: voice.test
operations.description: Save a range test the person sang (the person only).
operations.label: Test voice

breaks.description: pitch jumps found in glides [{at, jump}] (JSON)

operations.name: health.get
operations.description: Voice health: today's load against the cap, light or rest day, flags (heavy yesterday, pain, bad check-in, ramp, see a doctor), voice checks of 60 days, voiced minutes of 28 days.
operations.label: Get health

operations.name: health.checkin
operations.description: The person answers a voice check (1 = fine to 5 = bad). (person only)
operations.label: Checkin health

operations.name: songs.list
operations.description: The library (lean for the agent): id, title, level, language, range and span, status, key shift, sections with stages.
operations.label: List song

q.description: words of the title, composer or first words

operations.name: songs.get
operations.description: One song: details, sections and stages, its fit for this voice, recent takes; --abc true adds the notation.
operations.label: Get song

operations.name: songs.check
operations.description: Check ABC notation with words without saving: every problem by line, verse and bar, the singing checks for the level (span, breath, source), the summary and the key that fits the singer.
operations.label: Check song

abc.description: the notation; pass it from a file: --abc "$(cat song.abc)"

song.description: check it as a change to this song (the rules songs.update applies), with what it changes

operations.name: songs.add
operations.description: Add a song or vocalise (refused with every problem listed when the notation, words, span or source are not right).
operations.label: Add song

message.description: id of the message that asked for it

note.description: one tip, shown on the practice screen

gloss.description: word-for-word English for songs in another language

duplicate.description: add another version of a title

operations.name: songs.update
operations.description: Change a song's details, its sections, the coach's note, the gloss or the notation (sections whose bars did not change keep their progress).
operations.label: Update song

operations.name: songs.words
operations.description: A song's words bar by bar: each sung note with its syllable in each verse, and the notation line it is written on. Read it before changing words, and name bars as it numbers them (a pickup is bar 0).
operations.label: Words song

bars.description: a bar or a range, e.g. 4-7

operations.name: songs.shift-words
operations.description: Move a verse's words one note earlier (--by -1) or later (--by 1), from one note to the end of its phrase (or of the song): the fix for words a note late or early. Answers with the bars as they now are.
operations.label: Shift words song

bar.description: the bar of the first syllable to move (as songs.words numbers it)

note.description: which sung note of that bar, from 1 (default 1)

operations.name: songs.set-words
operations.description: Lay words on the sung notes of some bars, in order: spaces part words, hyphens part syllables, each Japanese, Chinese or Korean character is a syllable, _ holds one over the next note; notes left over hold the last syllable. A new verse number adds a verse. Answers with the bars as they now are.
operations.label: Set words song

bars.description: a bar or a range, e.g. 4-7

text.description: the words, e.g. "sa-i go no ki-su wa"

operations.name: songs.open
operations.description: The person opens a song to sing (the model, the key that fits). (person only)
operations.label: Open song

operations.name: songs.transpose
operations.description: The person sings a song in another key (semitones; stages are kept per key). (person only)
operations.label: Transpose song

operations.name: songs.backing
operations.description: Attach the recording a song was made from as its backing track (multipart: file, map with the beats found); then, with part=voice or part=music, the voice or the music separated from it (ogg, opus, wav or webm); or take them all off with remove=true. (person only)
operations.label: Backing song

map.description: {bpm, beats, downbeat, beat_q, bar1_q, duration, channels, source} (JSON)

remove.description: take the recording, voice and music off

operations.name: songs.remove
operations.description: Remove a song from the library (restorable). (person only)
operations.label: Remove song

operations.name: songs.restore
operations.description: Restore a removed song. (person only)
operations.label: Restore song

operations.name: songs.reset
operations.description: Start a song over (its sections back to new). (person only)
operations.label: Reset song

operations.name: runs.save
operations.description: Save one take (the practice screen does this after every take). (person only)
operations.label: Save run

operations.name: runs.list
operations.description: Recent takes with their numbers (pitch share, in-tune share, cents bias, steadiness, vibrato, timing).
operations.label: List run

operations.name: runs.get
operations.description: One take in detail: per phrase and per note (status, cents, onset, scoop/fall/vibrato flags).
operations.label: Get run

operations.name: runs.dispute
operations.description: The person disputes a judged note; the take is scored again without it. (person only)
operations.label: Dispute run

operations.name: runs.track
operations.description: Store a take's pitch track (and audio when recordings are kept). (person only)
operations.label: Track run

operations.name: runs.forget-audio
operations.description: Delete every stored recording. (person only)
operations.label: Forget audio run

operations.name: sessions.list
operations.description: Practice sessions: minutes, voiced minutes, vocal dose, warm-up and cool-down, songs, reviews.
operations.label: List session

operations.name: sessions.get
operations.description: One session with its takes.
operations.label: Get session

operations.name: sessions.end
operations.description: The person ends the session (asks the coach for a review when it lasted 3 minutes or more). (person only)
operations.label: End session

operations.name: sessions.review
operations.description: The coach writes the session's review (3-6 sentences; writing again replaces it). (coach only)
operations.label: Review session

operations.name: review.pack
operations.description: Everything to review a session, under about 6,000 characters: takes with numbers, the weakest phrase and its words, stage changes, drills, lessons, voice checks, health flags, units, and what the microphone cannot hear.
operations.label: Pack review

operations.name: coach.list
operations.description: The conversation.
operations.label: List coach

operations.name: coach.get
operations.description: One message of the person's with what they were looking at, the conversation before it, their level, voice and health.
operations.label: Get coach

operations.name: coach.send
operations.description: The person writes to the coach. (person only)
operations.label: Send coach

operations.name: coach.reply
operations.description: The coach answers a message (songs added with --message show under it). --message is required; to write to the person unasked (a plan, a nudge), pass --new true instead. (coach only)
operations.label: Reply coach

message.description: id of the message answered (coach.list shows the pending ones)

new.description: a message nobody asked for (instead of --message)

operations.name: coach.unsend
operations.description: Take back one of the coach's own messages (a mistake): within 30 minutes and before the person has read it; the question it answered waits again. (coach only)
operations.label: Unsend coach

operations.name: coach.read
operations.description: The person has read the coach's messages. (person only)
operations.label: Read coach

operations.name: coach.retry
operations.description: Ask the coach again. (person only)
operations.label: Retry coach

operations.name: plan.today
operations.description: Today's plan (stored, or the rules' plan): blocks with kind, minutes, why, sitting.
operations.label: Today plan

operations.name: plan.start
operations.description: The person starts today's plan. (person only)
operations.label: Start plan

operations.name: plan.done
operations.description: Tick a block of today's plan. (person only)
operations.label: Done plan

operations.name: plan.set
operations.description: The coach proposes a plan (today if not started, else tomorrow), checked against the health rules: warm-up first (5 min+), cool-down last (3 min+), near the goal, songs that fit the voice, gentle work on light days, no singing on rest days.
operations.label: Set plan

blocks.description: a JSON list of blocks (see app.guide) (JSON)

operations.name: plan.reset
operations.description: Back to the app's own plan for today. (person only)
operations.label: Reset plan

operations.name: stats.home
operations.description: The dashboard: 30 days of minutes, voiced minutes, pitch and in-tune shares, steadiness; streak; level; voice; load; voice map; songs in progress.
operations.label: Home stat

operations.name: stats.song
operations.description: One song over time: tempo ladders per section, minutes and pitch share per day, trouble bars.
operations.label: Song stat

operations.name: stats.voice
operations.description: The voice over time: range tests, steadiness, sustain, health and load, the voice map.
operations.label: Voice stat

operations.name: learn.state
operations.description: The curriculum and the path (lean for the agent): level, lessons done, the next lesson, the weakest requirement and skill, what the level still misses, plan block examples.
operations.label: State learn

operations.name: learn.lesson
operations.description: The person finished a lesson. (person only)
operations.label: Lesson learn

operations.name: drills.save
operations.description: Save a drill run. (person only)
operations.label: Save drill

operations.name: drills.list
operations.description: Recent drill runs.
operations.label: List drill

operations.name: abc.parse
operations.description: Parse notation into the practice model without saving.
operations.label: Parse abc

operations.name: models.part
operations.description: One 16 MB part of a model file the page uses to turn a recording into a song: Demucs (voice and music apart) and Whisper (the words), fetched once from Hugging Face at a pinned revision and kept on this computer. Answers bytes, not JSON; the page asks for these, an agent has no need to.
operations.label: Part model
